AadhaarConsentInput.description: The hire's consent to store their Aadhaar, and for what (PRD §7.10 Aadhaar, Retention).
AadhaarConsentInput.title: AadhaarConsentInput

AgentLLM.description: An alias from llm.yaml, or a connector and model; `params` are sampling params only.
AgentLLM.title: AgentLLM

AgentResolvedLLM.description:
The connector and model the agent runs on: its manifest's choice resolved through llm.yaml and
the environment (UI-8, FR-A2). Provider params are never part of it.
AgentResolvedLLM.title: AgentResolvedLLM

AgentsEnvelope.description: Every registered agent, retired ones included, by name.
AgentsEnvelope.title: AgentsEnvelope

AlternativeIdType.description:
The ID a hire may give instead of Aadhaar (PRD §7.10 Aadhaar). Only the type is recorded here;
the document itself is an encrypted upload (HIRE-2).
AlternativeIdType.title: AlternativeIdType

Approver.description: Who decides an approval task: a `user_ref` variable, a platform role, or one user id.
Approver.title: Approver

AuditRecordsEnvelope.description: One page of the org's audit records, newest first; `meta.page` has the total.
AuditRecordsEnvelope.title: AuditRecordsEnvelope

CallbackQuery.description: Bot API `CallbackQuery`: `id`, `from`, `chat_instance` always; `data` for a callback button.
CallbackQuery.title: CallbackQuery

ChatConfirmRequest.description: `POST /runs/{id}/chat/confirm`: HR confirms one proposal the assistant made in this run's chat.
ChatConfirmRequest.title: ChatConfirmRequest

ChatEnvelope.description: The stored conversation about one run, oldest first.
ChatEnvelope.title: ChatEnvelope

ChatRequest.description: `POST /runs/{id}/chat`: one question. Free text; it is redacted before it is stored or sent on.
ChatRequest.title: ChatRequest

ConfirmEnvelope.description: The run after the confirmed retry.
ConfirmEnvelope.title: ConfirmEnvelope

DocumentMeta.description: A scan as anyone sees it (FR-P3): `documents_meta` holds exactly this, plus `org_id`.
DocumentMeta.title: DocumentMeta

DocumentType.description:
What a scan shows: Aadhaar or PAN (PRD FR-P3), or the alternative ID a hire gives instead of
Aadhaar (`hires.AlternativeIdType`).
DocumentType.title: DocumentType

DocumentsEnvelope.description: The scans of one hire, oldest first (UI-4): metadata only.
DocumentsEnvelope.title: DocumentsEnvelope

DraftCreate.description: `POST /templates/drafts`: a new draft from a template body.
DraftCreate.title: DraftCreate

DraftUpdate.description:
`PUT /templates/drafts/{id}`: the whole new body. With `revision`, the save applies only to that
revision (409 otherwise), so two editors cannot overwrite each other unseen.
DraftUpdate.title: DraftUpdate

ErrorDetail.description: One problem with the request: where (`field`, a dotted location) and what (`issue`), never the value.
ErrorDetail.title: ErrorDetail

ErrorEnvelope.description: An error answer: `success` is false, `error` says why, `data` is null.
ErrorEnvelope.title: ErrorEnvelope

EvalMetrics.description: One (agent, category) group. Rates are 0..1, or null when the group has nothing to rate.
EvalMetrics.title: EvalMetrics

EvalRun.description: One run in full: `metrics[agent][category]`, the gates, and each case's passes.
EvalRun.title: EvalRun

EvalRunSummary.description: A run in the list: what was evaluated and whether its gates passed.
EvalRunSummary.title: EvalRunSummary

EvalRunsEnvelope.description: The org's eval runs, newest first, paged.
EvalRunsEnvelope.title: EvalRunsEnvelope

HirePiiInput.description: The sensitive values given at creation. Email is required: hires are deduplicated by it.
HirePiiInput.title: HirePiiInput

HireRecord.description: A hire as every role sees it: sensitive fields masked (FR-P1), keyed by field.
HireRecord.title: HireRecord

HiresEnvelope.description: One page of hires, masked; `meta.page` has the total.
HiresEnvelope.title: HiresEnvelope

MockOutboxMessage.description: One message the Telegram mock "sent": the recipient masked, never raw (PRD §7.10).
MockOutboxMessage.title: MockOutboxMessage

NewHireRequest.description: `POST /hires`. An Aadhaar needs `aadhaar_consent`; a hire who declines gives `alternative_id`.
NewHireRequest.title: NewHireRequest

PiiAccess.description: The vault fields a task may resolve, and the one sink that resolves them (PRD §7.10).
PiiAccess.title: PiiAccess

PiiAccessEnvelope.description: One page of the org's PII access log, newest first; `meta.page` has the total.
PiiAccessEnvelope.title: PiiAccessEnvelope

PiiAccessRecord.description: One entry of `pii_access_log` (FR-P5): who saw which field of which hire, masked, and why.
PiiAccessRecord.title: PiiAccessRecord

PiiField.description: The sensitive fields of a hire (PRD §7.10). Document scans are HIRE-2's.
PiiField.title: PiiField

PiiUpdateRequest.description: `PUT /hires/{id}/pii/{field}`: a new value (a new vault version and token, FR-P4).
PiiUpdateRequest.title: PiiUpdateRequest

ProposalRecord.description: A change the assistant proposed. Nothing has happened yet: `pending` until HR confirms it.
ProposalRecord.title: ProposalRecord

RevealEnvelope.description: A revealed value. Not cached (`Cache-Control: no-store`).
RevealEnvelope.title: RevealEnvelope

RevealedValue.description: One revealed value; the UI hides it again after `expires_in_seconds`.
RevealedValue.title: RevealedValue

RunCreate.description: `POST /runs`: start a run for a hire on a published template version (FR-R1).
RunCreate.title: RunCreate

RunEnvelope.description: A run that was just started.
RunEnvelope.title: RunEnvelope

RunRecord.description: A run, pinned to the template version and DAG hash it was compiled from.
RunRecord.title: RunRecord

RunSummary.description: A run in a list: no tasks (`GET /runs/{id}` has them).
RunSummary.title: RunSummary

RunsEnvelope.description: One page of runs, newest first; `meta.page` has the total.
RunsEnvelope.title: RunsEnvelope

Sla.description: `due` is a date variable with an optional offset: `start_date - 7d`, `start_date + 48h`.
Sla.title: Sla

TaskCompleteRequest.description: `POST /runs/{id}/tasks/{task_id}/complete`: HR says the task is done and why (FR-R5).
TaskCompleteRequest.title: TaskCompleteRequest

TelegramMessage.description: Bot API `Message` (or `InaccessibleMessage`, whose `date` is 0): the message the button was on.
TelegramMessage.title: TelegramMessage

TelegramUpdate.description: Bot API `Update`. Only `callback_query` updates mean anything here; others are acknowledged.
TelegramUpdate.title: TelegramUpdate

TelegramUser.description: Bot API `User`; only `id` is used (as the decider's Telegram id). Names are never stored.
TelegramUser.title: TelegramUser

Template.description: A template draft or version: variables and a task graph (`depends_on` edges).
Template.title: Template

TemplateIssue.description: One FR-T3 problem: the rule, the task it is about (or none) and a message without raw values.
TemplateIssue.title: TemplateIssue

TemplateSummary.description: `GET /templates`: one row per template key, with every version's status.
TemplateSummary.title: TemplateSummary

TemplateTask.description: One node of the template graph. `inputs` reach the task's agent, so they are LLM-visible.
TemplateTask.title: TemplateTask

TemplateValidation.description: `POST /templates/drafts/{id}/validate`: the report against the current registry.
TemplateValidation.title: TemplateValidation

TemplateVersionRecord.description: One published version: its key, its immutable body and where it came from.
TemplateVersionRecord.title: TemplateVersionRecord

expires_at.description: Unix time (seconds) when the token stops being accepted
expires_at.title: Expires At

Variable.description: A hire variable the template reads (`role`, `start_date`, `manager_id`...).
Variable.title: Variable

WebhookAck.description: The same answer for every accepted update, so the response tells a caller nothing.
WebhookAck.title: WebhookAck

200.description: Server-sent events: task, run and end.
